svg.text: Kaya: one twin per patient, three ways to use it
A multi-organ digital twin for Type 2 Diabetes. It shows what glucose does to the liver, eyes and kidneys, and lets you test a change before trying it on the real patient.
Open + synthetic data only · Decision support

dose and emergency rules run in code
open + synthetic data, key stays server-side

LOOP: LOGS AND QUESTIONS FEED THE TWIN
Kaya is decision support for clinicians, not a diagnostic device. All patients are synthetic; metrics are out-of-sample.
Team Kaya · IIT Hyderabad · Digital Twin Challenge, Phase 1
